canCreateStocks.title: Create stocks
canCreateStocks.description: Specifies whether the user is able to create new stocks.

canEditStockNames.title: Edit stock names
canEditStockNames.description: Specifies whether the user is able to modify the name and shorthand of a stock.

canEditStockColors.title: Edit stock color
canEditStockColors.description: Specifies whether the user can edit the color associated with a stock.

canEditStockPrices.title: Edit stock prices
canEditStockPrices.description: Specifies whether the user can change the price of a stock directly. This allows the user to set the price of a stock. Influencing the stock with an article is a separate permission and this permission is not required for the user to affect stocks in articles!

canArchiveStocks.title: Archive stocks
canArchiveStocks.description: Specifies whether the user can set a stock to be archived. This also includes the ability to set an archived stock's state back to active. This however does not come with the ability to see archived stocks.

isStockArchivist.title: View archived stocks
isStockArchivist.description: Specifies whether the user can view archived stocks. This does not grant the ability to archive or unarchive a stock.

canCreateStockGroups.title: Create stock groups
canCreateStockGroups.description: Specifies whether the user is able to create new stock groups.

canEditStockGroupNames.title: Edit the name of stock groups
canEditStockGroupNames.description: Specifies whether the user can change the name of an existing stock group.

canEditStockGroupDescriptions.title: Edit the description of stock groups
canEditStockGroupDescriptions.description: Specifies whether the user can modify the description of an existing stock group.

canEditStockGroupMembers.title: Change members of stock groups
canEditStockGroupMembers.description: Specifies whether the user can change the stock members of a stock group.

canDeleteStockGroups.title: Delete stock groups
canDeleteStockGroups.description: Specifies whether the user can delete stock groups permanently.

canCreateArticles.title: Write articles
canCreateArticles.description: Specifies whether the user can write new articles. This permission does not implicitly grant the ability to also affect stocks with the new article!

canEditArticles.title: Edit articles
canEditArticles.description: Specifies whether the user can edit already existing articles. This includes both the name and content.

canModifyInfluences.title: Change article influences
canModifyInfluences.description: Specifies whether the user can set, change and remove influences from existing articles and set influences on new articles. The highest influence possible is determined by another permission.

maxInfluencePermille.title: Maximum influence in permille
maxInfluencePermille.description: The highest influence a user can set for an influence. The value is an absolute value, so setting this to 10 allows the user to set an influence between -10 and 10 permille. If set to -1, there is no limit.

canCreateUsers.title: Create users
canCreateUsers.description: Specifies whether the user can add new users.

canEditUserPermissions.title: Change other user's permissions
canEditUserPermissions.description: Specifies whether the user is able to change the permissions of other users. The user has to also bear the permissions to change them for others.

canEditUserName.title: Change other user's names
canEditUserName.description: Specifies whether the user can change other user's display name and tag.

canEditUserPassword.title: Change other user's password
canEditUserPassword.description: Specifies whether the user can reset other user's password to a specific value. This new password has to be changed upon the next login of this user. Be careful when distributing this permission as a user with this permission could hijack the account of another as one can then log in with the reset password and subsequently log into the other account.

canDisableUsers.title: Disable users
canDisableUsers.description: Specifies whether the user can disable another user. Such a user is barred from authenticating and performing anything. This permission also grant the ability to enable disabled users.

canDeleteUsers.title: Delete users
canDeleteUsers.description: Specifies whether the user can delete other users permanently. If the user to delete previously created anything, the authorship is removed. Stars and views are also permanently deleted and thus deducted from the total count.
